title.en: The same recipe with and without a person in the kitchen

goal.en: Cutting may not run unattended, whatever the device. With a person present the arm cuts under its camera and the person does the cooking the arm cannot; a full kitchen robot still needs the person for the knife work.

note.en: Shakshuka on the example arm, nobody home: refused at the first step.
With a person: accepted. The arm cuts (verified by its camera) and later cracks the eggs; heating, sauteing, simmering and serving are assigned to the person.
The kitchen robot with hob and thermometers can do every operation, and is still refused alone: the envelope for cutting says unattended is false.
With a person nearby the robot does all thirteen steps itself; heating is verified by the pan thermometer.

outcome.en: You know that presence is a safety input, not a convenience: a step the envelope marks unattended=false is refused when nobody is there. Next: scenario 028 collects the refusals an agent sees when nobody is home.
